programChanges.summary: Installer recovery release with a unified graphite interface and complete Qt runtime deployment
added: Graphite Qt IFW styling for installation, maintenance, update, uninstall, progress, and error states
Explicit uninstall choice for retaining or permanently removing user data
Release packaging checks for co-located Qt runtime libraries, platform plugins, and QML modules
changed: Installed Qt runtime libraries beside ToDoIt.exe so a clean Windows machine can start the application
Localized installer page titles, guidance, buttons, license acceptance, and completion messages
Expanded the installer window and page list to match the approved compact graphite design
